key_insight: Local System 1 agents select tools and fill arguments without generating text, avoiding invented content in evaluated tool calls.
clinical_relevance: This approach could support local analysis of sensitive clinical data without sending patient information to cloud LLMs.
method: A deterministic compiler converts tool schemas and requests into multiple-choice questions.
Answer options come from the request and tool schema.
A one-pass decision model selects answers to construct tool calls.
evidence_signal: Across 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best agent achieved 97.0% correct tool selection or refusal versus 95.2% for the best local LLM setting, filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values, and produced no invented content in calls versus 5.5–19.7% for LLMs.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish clinical safety; real-world workflows still require validation and handling of incorrect selections or arguments.
paper_title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
